story.title: Why Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic
paragraphs: Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic was set up to give Tadepalle a dental practice where nobody feels rushed. It sits on the first floor of Perreddy Complex at Pathur Road Cross, close to Reliance Digital and the Vijayawada–Guntur road.
Dr. Ramakanth, who holds an MDS (Master of Dental Surgery), sees every patient. That means one familiar face from your first check-up to your follow-up visits, and a dentist who knows your history.
Our approach is simple: examine carefully, explain clearly, and only recommend treatment that you need. Children, nervous patients and older family members are all welcome.

clinicHead.title: Dr. Ramakanth, MDS
clinicHead.lead: Every consultation is with Dr. Ramakanth — from routine check-ups to root canals and wisdom tooth removal.

items.title: We explain first
items.text: What we found, your options, the number of visits and the cost — before treatment starts.

items.title: Clean and safe
items.text: Sterilised instruments for every patient and disposable items used once.

items.title: Gentle with everyone
items.text: Extra time for children, anxious patients and older family members.

items.title: Records that follow you
items.text: Your visits, prescriptions and treatment plans are kept securely on ClinicFlow247 and available in your patient account.

team.title: The team
